image.subject: a stern English army major in his forties, powdered wig, dark blue wool coat, bent over a dessert apple held in his gloved hand, eyes fixed on it greedily, in a colonial orchard at dusk

storyboard.claim: He wants to own the miracle apple.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The major clutching a single apple like treasure
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Follows his obsession with the apple taste
storyboard.addedInformation: He wants possession, not just land

image.subject: a wooden boundary post being hammered into a field by a laborer, a branding iron glowing on the ground beside it, colonial farmland in the morning

storyboard.claim: He needs to brand what he buys.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A stake and a branding iron marking the land

storyboard.claim: He buys a 500 acre parcel.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Big number card
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Gives the size of the purchase
storyboard.addedInformation: The scale of the land bought

image.subject: a carpenter with a hammer in hand pointing at a ruined low stone cabin overgrown with moss in a forest clearing, the stern major shaking his head beside him

storyboard.claim: The carpenter wants the old cabin torn down.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Carpenter pointing at the ruin, major refusing
storyboard.addedInformation: The cabin is where the captive mother lived

image.subject: a ruined low stone cabin with a collapsed roof and moss-covered walls in a forest clearing in colonial Massachusetts, pale evening light, undisturbed

storyboard.claim: He refuses and keeps the ruin.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The old stone cabin left standing

image.subject: a neat symmetrical lemon yellow wooden colonial house built flush against the wall of an old ruined stone cabin in a forest clearing, morning light

storyboard.claim: The yellow house is built onto the ruins.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Pristine yellow house attached to the stone ruin

image.subject: the crumbling dark stone wall of an old cabin joined seamlessly to the bright clean clapboard of a yellow house, close view of the seam, dappled forest light

storyboard.claim: Civilized life is grafted onto the wild past.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The seam where yellow clapboard meets old stone
storyboard.addedInformation: The past is built into the home

image.subject: a hand-lettered wooden crate label reading nothing legible, a ripe red apple on a worn table beside a quill pen and an inkwell, candlelight

storyboard.claim: He names the fruit after himself.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A freshly named apple beside a quill

image.subject: an Indigenous family in simple deerskin clothing standing at the edge of a misty forest meadow at dawn, looking toward the trees, quiet and still

storyboard.claim: The name ignores the people who were here for millennia.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Indigenous people at the forest edge
storyboard.addedInformation: The first people are erased from the name

left.label: SKIPPED
left.subject: an Indigenous family in deerskin clothing at the edge of a misty forest meadow at dawn

right.label: CHOSEN
right.subject: a stern English army major in his forties, powdered wig, dark blue wool coat, holding a red apple proudly

storyboard.claim: He did not honor the people or the scout.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Two ghost names against his own
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Contrasts the names skipped with the name chosen
storyboard.addedInformation: The scout whose corpse fed the seed goes unnamed

image.subject: a gang of rough scarred men in ragged work clothes around a smoky campfire in a forest, two of them shoving each other angrily, axes leaning on a tree

storyboard.claim: He hires violent men from the Albany docks.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Scarred laborers brawling around a camp
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Describes how the road is built

image.subject: a wide raw road hacked through an ancient forest, huge pine stumps and felled trunks lying everywhere, men with axes in the distance, grey morning

storyboard.claim: They clearcut the ancient trees for a road.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Stumps and felled trunks along a raw road

image.subject: straight rows of young fruit trees and a ruler-straight stone-edged path laid out across cleared ground, a surveyor with a measuring chain standing at one end, wild forest behind

storyboard.claim: He imposes rigid English geometry on the land.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Straight orchard rows against wild forest

image.subject: a major's weathered gloved hand carving a name into a pale tree trunk with a knife, bark curls falling, orchard in soft light

storyboard.claim: He puts his name on a miracle he did not make.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Hand carving a name into a trunk

storyboard.claim: He thinks he can buy the magic.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Bold phrase card
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Punchline of the first speaker's case

image.subject: a stern English army major in his forties, powdered wig, dark blue wool coat, sitting alone at night beside a single candle, haunted eyes staring at a bandaged chest, an old musket on the wall behind him

storyboard.claim: The other host sees a traumatized visionary.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The major alone with his wound and a candle
storyboard.addedInformation: Reframes him as wounded, not arrogant

image.subject: an apple cut in half on a wooden table showing its seeds, a farmer's hand pointing at one seed, soft window light in a colonial kitchen

storyboard.claim: Apples are extremely heterozygous.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Halved apple and its seeds
storyboard.addedInformation: The seed does not breed true

storyboard.claim: What does it mean for the layman?
storyboard.concreteVisual: Question card

image.subject: a small sour wild crab apple hanging on a gnarled branch, a farmer pulling a face as he bites one, orchard in grey light

storyboard.claim: Seeds from a sweet apple grow bitter fruit.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A farmer grimacing at a sour crab apple

storyboard.claim: Almost every seed is a loser.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Big number card
storyboard.addedInformation: Every seed is a lottery ticket

image.subject: a young apple sapling pushing up from dark disturbed soil in a forest clearing, a single bright new leaf, light rays through pines

storyboard.claim: A seed from a corpse made a world-class fruit.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Sapling rising from the grave soil
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Applies the odds to the book
storyboard.addedInformation: Why this apple is a miracle

image.subject: fallen red apples rotting on wet ground with flies, a thin grey wolf sniffing at one at the edge of a forest in cold light

storyboard.claim: Before Osgood the apple only rotted and fed animals.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Rotting apples, a wolf and flies
storyboard.addedInformation: Nobody valued it until he did

image.subject: a stern English army major in his forties, powdered wig, dark blue wool coat, tasting a slice of apple with closed eyes and a look of wonder, holding a small paring knife, bright orchard behind him

storyboard.claim: Osgood recognizes its superior quality.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The major savoring a slice

image.subject: a stern English army major in his forties, powdered wig, dark blue wool coat, standing before a table with a rolled military commission and a sealed letter, turning away from it toward a window showing an orchard

storyboard.claim: He abandons a military promotion.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Major turning from a commission to the orchard
storyboard.addedInformation: He gives up prestige for the tree

image.subject: a group of wealthy colonial relatives in fine clothes sitting around a dining table, pointing and sneering at a worn man in a plain coat, a lawyer with papers at the end of the table

storyboard.claim: His family tries to have him declared a lunatic.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Relatives and a lawyer against the major

storyboard.claim: Pomomania means an obsession with apples.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A physician studying an apple drawing

image.subject: a colonial woman in a bonnet holding a sheep's udder toward a reluctant man in a nightshirt in a barn, the sheep standing placidly, lantern light

storyboard.claim: They try to cure him by sniffing sheep udders.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A man made to sniff a sheep in a barn

image.subject: a stern English army major in his forties, powdered wig, dark blue wool coat, kneeling in a blossoming apple orchard at dawn, a hand on a young trunk, an unsigned ledger of debts open on the grass beside him

storyboard.claim: He risks reputation and fortune for beauty.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Major kneeling among blossoming trees

image.subject: a ruined stone cabin wall with a young apple tree growing beside it, a man's hand resting gently on the old stones, soft evening light

storyboard.claim: He keeps the cabin out of respect for its history.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Hand resting on the old stone wall

storyboard.claim: But there is a human cost to his stewardship.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Phrase card

image.subject: two young colonial sisters in plain dresses standing side by side at an upstairs window of a yellow house, looking out at a vast empty forest with no neighbors, grey light

storyboard.claim: He isolates his two daughters in the middle of nowhere.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Two girls at a window facing wilderness
storyboard.addedInformation: Cut off from society and partners

image.subject: a thick stack of handwritten pages crowded with scrawled lines on a rough desk, a quill and a half-eaten apple, a candle burning low in a colonial study

storyboard.claim: He writes a manic manuscript about his genius.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Overflowing pages of handwriting

image.subject: a colonial farmer in a hat laughing as a rival farmer in a neighboring field spreads manure over his own crops, shaggy untrimmed apple trees in the foreground

storyboard.claim: He boasts of shaggy trees and tricking a rival into fertilizing with waste.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A rival fertilizing his field, orchard behind

storyboard.claim: It is all driven by a massive fragile ego.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Phrase card

image.subject: a stern English army major in his forties, powdered wig, dark blue wool coat, holding a rolled paper deed with a red wax seal up against an apple tree, as if showing the tree it belongs to him

storyboard.claim: He believes the paper deed means he owns the tree.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Major presenting a deed to the tree

storyboard.claim: The tree controls his life.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Deed versus tree
storyboard.addedInformation: The tree dictates where he lives

image.subject: a stern English army major in his forties, powdered wig, dark blue wool coat, in shirtsleeves and exhausted, digging around the base of an apple tree under an early morning sky, children's small shoes left by the door of a yellow house behind

storyboard.claim: The tree dictates how he spends every hour and raises his children.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The major bent over the tree at dawn
storyboard.addedInformation: His days and family bend to it

image.subject: a stern English army major in his forties, powdered wig, dark blue wool coat, wrapped in a blanket in a freezing dark orchard at night holding a lantern, a porcupine climbing a trunk beside him and small birds in the branches

storyboard.claim: He worries all night about porcupines and waxwings.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Major keeping watch with a lantern

storyboard.claim: The tree domesticated him.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Quotation card

storyboard.claim: Owning a mansion means it owns your money and weekends.
storyboard.concreteVisual: An owner overwhelmed by a big old house

image.subject: a lone old apple tree in full leaf standing tall over a small figure of a man in a coat with a spade, the yellow house tiny behind them, sweeping golden light

storyboard.claim: He is only seasonal help and the tree outlasts him.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Tall tree over a small gardener
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Ties back to the main argument

storyboard.claim: The place, not the people, is the true owner.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Phrase card

image.subject: a stern English army major in his forties, powdered wig, dark blue wool coat, mounting a horse in the yard of a yellow house at dawn with a musket slung on his back, two young daughters watching from the doorstep

storyboard.claim: Osgood marches off to the Revolutionary War, leaving his daughters.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Major riding away from two girls on a doorstep

image.subject: a yellow wooden house with shuttered windows and tall uncut grass around it, a single clock stopped on the wall seen through a window, still winter light

storyboard.claim: Those who hold on to the land freeze it in time.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A shuttered house stopped in time

storyboard.claim: How does isolation twist the need for a legacy?
storyboard.concreteVisual: Question card
storyboard.addedInformation: Asks the question that the next scene answers

image.subject: an adult colonial woman in a plain dark dress and white cap standing alone on the porch of a yellow house, hand shading her eyes, looking across a golden overgrown meadow

storyboard.claim: The scene turns to Mary Osgood.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A woman on the porch looking at the meadow
